complexity.notes: Initializing best_buy to 100 relies on the stated constraint prices[i] <= 100, which is guaranteed here; using prices[0] or float('inf') would be more robust and idiomatic. Iterating directly over the list (for p in prices) would be cleaner than range(len(prices)).
complexity.summary: Single pass tracking the minimum price seen so far (best_buy) and the maximum profit achievable by selling at each day, returning the best profit found.
